_published_faq.name: How do I add Dincer Logistics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Dincer Logistics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://3wsieuxc42.execute-api.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Dincer Logistics MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dincer Logistics provides these MCP tools: query_data and sources_status.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Dincer Logistics?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Dincer Logistics in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Dincer Logistics MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dincer Logistics requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Dincer Logistics is developed by Dincer Logistics. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
